corrections.old_text: በሱ፡ ያመነ፡ ግን፡ ይከብራል፡ ሮሜ፡ ፫፡ ፬ ።
corrections.corrected_text: በሱ፡ ያመነ፡ ግን፡ ይከብራል፡ ሮሜ፡ ፫፡ ፳ ።
corrections.reason: The printed numeral has two vertical strokes between the top and bottom bars (፳ = 20, referencing Romans 3:20), distinct from the round-looped ፬ (4) seen in ፵፬ (Col 2 L31).
Both the printed glyph and Classical Ge'ez grammar (from ፈቀደ, 'ወኢትፈቅዱ ርእሰክሙ ለሕይወት ዘለዓለም') confirm ዱ rather than ዩ.
Stage 1 misread the Ethiopic Fidel ወ inside ወሀወከዎን ('and they stirred up/troubled them', from ሀወከ) as a non-Ethiopic Greek character υ.
